competition.name: DOE Geospatial Geothermal Exploration Machine Learning (GEMS) Prize

run_card.hypothesis: H-K1-1 (HMAS-SINTER-ENV): Blind hydrothermal conduit faults missed by Quaternary scarp catalogues exhibit linear negative magnetic tilt-curvature / 3-D analytic-signal demagnetization troughs (titanomagnetite -> hematite/pyrite/clay oxidation), positive Poisson pseudo-gravity orthogonal basement steps, 4-block standardized GeoDAWN 214Bi radon & K/Th alteration crests, and strike-projected INGENIOUS 2m temperature probe (F2mDAB), Quaternary sinter/breccia, and quartz-geothermometer plumes; fusing Dual-Cover (M_Full inside 75.37% 1m LiDAR + quantile-matched LiDAR-free M_Sub inside the 24.63% gap) with hydrothermal conduit modulation and d=2.9px axial-spaced submodular 300m kernel allocation recovers detached & off-catalogue faults without neighbor clumping.
run_card.mechanism: 150-300C hydrothermal upflow along permeable Great Basin normal/transtensional fault damage zones destroys host-rock magnetite while depositing silica sinter/breccia and shallow conductive clay caps, creating contrarian magnetic troughs paired with upward-continued (400-1800m) non-magnetic basement gravity gradients and strike-elongated F2mDAB thermal & 214Bi radon anomalies under Holocene fill.
run_card.mimic_process: Late Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shoreline benches (sharp 1m DEM steps inside deep basin fill with zero basement gravity gradient), US Census TIGER highway/railroad embankments (<=140m symmetric berms), tabular Neogene basalt/ash-flow lava margins (removed via 2-D FFT 1/|k| Poisson pseudo-gravity orthogonal regression), and flat conductive evaporite playas (vetoed where slope < 1.8 deg and cover > 320m).

comparison_rows.method_short: 58-ch HMAS Mag-Trough + PPGR + F2mDAB/Sinter Dual-Cover GBDT + d=2.9px Submodular
comparison_rows.exec_summary: Dedicated H-K1-1 (HMAS-SINTER-ENV) architecture built from scratch on the leak-checked 58-channel stack. Combines negative magnetic tilt-curvature / 3-D analytic-signal magnetite-destruction troughs, 2-D FFT 1/|k| Poisson pseudo-gravity orthogonal basement residuals, 4-block standardized GeoDAWN 214Bi radon & K/Th alteration crests, and strike-projected INGENIOUS F2mDAB (2,782 probes), Quaternary sinter/breccia (281 sites), and quartz-geothermometer plumes via Dual-Cover cross-fitting (M_Full inside 75.37% 1m LiDAR + quantile-matched LiDAR-free M_Sub inside the 24.63% gap) and d=2.9px 300m submodular kernel emission. Beats BASE_35 on gems57 detached (+0.0106, 95% CI [+0.0056, +0.0158]) and beats the 0.2778 Champion on off-catalogue USGS SGMC bedrock faults (+0.0184, 95% CI [+0.0016, +0.0355]) with only 46.44% 3-px overlap with GEMSDOE32 (20,461 of 38,200 dots = 53.56% genuinely novel fault placements >300 m away).

comparison_rows.method_short: H33-2 B=2.0px Catalogue-Halo-Stripped H27-4/H19-5 Poisson-Disk d=2.8px
comparison_rows.exec_summary: Registry leader (0.2778 OWNER-REPORT). Achieved a +0.0070 gain over GEMSDOE28's 0.2708 baseline (h27-4-r1-solo-d2-8, 40,199 dots) via a single surgical geometric operation: expanding the Euclidean exclusion collar around mapped catalogue faults (labels.tif) from B=1.0 px to B=2.0 px (min d_cat = 2.24 px). That stripped exactly 2,545 near-catalogue halo dots (leaving 37,654 binary 1.0 dots, 0 NaNs, -zeros convention) whose 300 m kernels overlapped already-saturated public fault traces and added pure 0.2*FP denominator drag. Also resolved an earlier portal range rejection caused by raw -3.4e38 Float32 sentinels in training_features.tif. Limitation: still inherits the scarp-dominated H19-5 surface (SGMC off-catalogue raw DTI = 0.093694).

comparison_rows.method_short: H33-2 Core (37,654 dots) + 1,200 Andersonian Geothermal PINN Extension Dots
comparison_rows.exec_summary: Second-highest owner-reported score (0.2750 OWNER-REPORT, 38,854 dots, -nan outside footprint). Retains 100% of GEMSDOE32's 37,654 H33-2 dots (97.40% <=3 px overlap — near-duplicate of GEMSDOE32) and appends 1,200 Andersonian stress / geothermal PINN dots. Because those 1,200 extra dots achieved lower marginal precision than the 0.0556 DTI breakeven threshold at 0.2778, adding them diluted DTI by -0.0028 (0.2778 -> 0.2750). A separate non-H19-5 experiment in GEMSDOE36 (kpl36-exp3, 44,500 dots) scored 0.1647 due to over-concentrating 81% of dots near existing fault tips (only 19.3% far-field >1.5 km).

comparison_rows.method_short: H27-4 Ridge-Centered Sub-Selection (40,199 dots) + H36-1 Relay Rungs (41,622 dots)
comparison_rows.exec_summary: Breakthrough intermediate stepping-stone (0.2708 on h27-4-r1-solo-d2-8 with 40,199 dots; 0.2710 with +1,423 H36-1 step-over relay rungs = 41,622 dots, 0 NaNs). Improved +0.0108 over GEMSDOE25's 0.2600 d2.8 baseline by re-centering Poisson-disk dots directly onto multi-scale Hessian ridge crests rather than off-axis flank pixels, maximizing the 1 - d/300m triangular kernel height. Still used only a B=1.0 px catalogue buffer, leaving 2,545 redundant halo dots that GEMSDOE32 later removed to reach 0.2778.

comparison_rows.method_short: H33d r=3.0px Analog-Tip Stepover Variant (37,068 dots); S33-1 Independent Playas (0.0963)
comparison_rows.exec_summary: Contrasts two extremes: its H19-5 thinned variant h33d-r30 (37,068 dots, 92.64% <=3 px overlap with GEMSDOE32) scored 0.2632 (OWNER-REPORT), whereas its independent S33-1 geophysical/radiometric model (37,654 dots) collapsed to 0.0963 because un-vetoed shallow conductivity and uranium anomalies spilled 18.8% of all emitted dots onto flat deep evaporite playas (slope < 2 deg, depth_to_base_surf > 300 m) and packed 14.3% of dots into redundant >=3-neighbor clumps.

comparison_rows.method_short: Poisson-Disk d=2.8px Thinning of H19-5 Surface (44,090 dots); H66 Basin Tracker (0.0742)
comparison_rows.exec_summary: Demonstrated the non-additive max-cover spacing law: increasing Poisson-disk inter-dot spacing on the H19-5 surface from d=1.5 px (60,069 dots, 0.2477 in GEMSDOE24) to d=2.8 px (44,090 dots) raised live DTI by +0.0123 to 0.2600 by cutting 15,979 redundant neighbor FP dots inside the 300 m kernel radius. Conversely, its independent H66 lineament model scored 0.0742 due to 16.4% flat-playa false-positive spill. Byte-identical d2.8 copies were also mirrored into GEMSDOE30 and GEMSDOE31.

comparison_rows.method_short: MSDB1 Multi-Scale Discontinuity Bridge (44,090 dots; also mirrors d2.8 0.2600)
comparison_rows.exec_summary: Hosts both a byte-exact mirror of the 0.2600 d2.8 raster (sha256: 91eae1ca...) and a genuinely independent architecture, MSDB1 (44,090 dots, 0.1462 OWNER-REPORT, 39.18% <=3 px overlap with GEMSDOE32). MSDB1 underperformed on live DTI because >10% of its dots clustered into >=3-neighbor clumps inside the non-additive max kernel and lacked 1 m LiDAR gap calibration or Lahontan shoreline vetoing.

comparison_rows.family: H19-5 Ensemble / Union Family (88.2% <=3px w/ GEMSDOE32)
comparison_rows.method_short: Mirrors d2.8 Baseline (44,090 dots) + Multi-Regime / Union Sweeps
comparison_rows.exec_summary: Explored set-union and regime-split variants across H19-5/H27-4 members (e.g., union-b-p060, 50,023 dots; pgr31 / h31aa-slfs-flexure, 37,654 dots) above the mirrored 0.2600 d2.8 baseline (sha256: 91eae1ca...). Audit finding: taking pixel unions of nested H19-5 rasters inflates dot count (>50k) and re-introduces sub-300 m neighbor collisions between shifted ridge discretizations.

comparison_rows.family: H19-5 Early Dense Family (88.5% <=3px w/ GEMSDOE32)
comparison_rows.method_short: Dense d=1.5px Dotted H19-5 (60,069 dots, +0.0563 over continuous H19-5 0.1914)
comparison_rows.exec_summary: First proof of the discrete dotting jump: converting continuous H19-5 probabilities (0.1914 live) into 60,069 discrete 1.0 dots at d=1.5 px spacing jumped live DTI by +0.0563 to 0.2477 (OWNER-REPORT) because DTI's TP uses max_{d<=300m} p*k(d) while FP sums p across all positive pixels. However, d=1.5 px still packed 2–3 dots inside every 300 m disk (60,069 vs optimal ~38,000). A later GVC1 gravity-volcanic model scored 0.0859 due to un-thinned cluster clumping and deep-basin spill.

comparison_rows.family: Strongest Prior Non-H19-5 Architecture (50.2% <=3px w/ GEMSDOE32)
comparison_rows.method_short: H31 Dual-Regime Cover-Gated GBDT + Walker Lane + CELF d=2.8px (37,654 dots)
comparison_rows.exec_summary: The strongest genuinely independent (non-H19-5) scored model in the prior registry (0.2250 OWNER-REPORT, 37,654 dots, 0 NaNs, only 50.23% <=3 px overlap with GEMSDOE32; earlier H19-5 gap-fill t-v2-d1.5 scored 0.2449). Pioneered cover-gated GBDT + CELF kernel thinning, but used raw 19-band features without 1 m LiDAR gap parity (M_Full vs LiDAR-free M_Sub), without hydrothermal magnetite-destruction troughs, without Poisson pseudo-gravity volcanic de-confounding, and without INGENIOUS F2mDAB / sinter plumes.
